description: ShedKeeper: a copy before every change, the trash instead of deletion

hooks.command: if [ -f "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/pre_tool.py" ]; then python "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/pre_tool.py" --via-plugin; rc=$?; if [ $rc -eq 126 ] || [ $rc -eq 127 ]; then printf '%s' '{"systemMessage": "ShedKeeper cannot run: Python was not found (or `python` is the Microsoft Store placeholder) -- its protection is OFF: no copy is saved before an edit, nothing goes to the trash. Install Python (python.org, tick Add python.exe to PATH) and restart Claude Code.", "hookSpecificOutput": {"hookEventName": "PreToolUse", "additionalContext": "ShedKeeper cannot run: Python was not found (or `python` is the Microsoft Store placeholder) -- the protection is OFF -- tell the person before changing or deleting files."}}'; exit 0; fi; exit $rc; else printf '%s' '{"systemMessage": "ShedKeeper plugin files were not found: its protection is OFF (no copy is saved before an edit, nothing goes to the trash). Reinstall it with /plugin install shedkeeper@shedkeeper, or remove it with /plugin uninstall shedkeeper@shedkeeper.", "hookSpecificOutput": {"hookEventName": "PreToolUse", "additionalContext": "ShedKeeper plugin files were not found: the protection is OFF -- tell the person. Do not edit the plugin cache by hand. The person reinstalls with /plugin install shedkeeper@shedkeeper or removes it with /plugin uninstall shedkeeper@shedkeeper (python <kit folder>/install.py install is the other way in)."}}'; fi
